judged_text: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/adapters/rest.js.es6:22 — type.replace('_', '-')` replaces only the first underscore (string, not `/g`), so the dasherize fallback silently fails for any future multi-word admin model; it also papers over records being hydrated with underscored `__type` (`embeddable_host`) while `createRecord('embeddable-host')` uses the dasherized name, leaving two identity-map buckets for the same model.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `basePath(store, type)` to check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_','-'))`, and `String#replace` only replaces the first underscore. With the current `ADMIN_MODELS` entries (`plugin`, `site-customization`, `embeddable-host`) this works, but it is brittle for any future admin model names with multiple underscores. However, the claim about “two identity-map buckets” due to underscored `__type` vs dasherized `createRecord('embeddable-host')` isn’t directly verifiable from this diff (no `__type` handling shown), so the finding is best treated as a robustness/maintainability concern rather than a proven bug in this PR.
